record.original_question: Let pi: X -> CP^2 be the blow-up of the complex projective plane at one point, let omega be a Kahler form in c_1(X), let D be a smooth anticanonical divisor, and let mu_D = omega wedge [D] / V be the normalized Lebesgue measure along D. Determine whether there exists phi_D in DMA(X, omega) such that MA(phi_D) = mu_D.

evidence.quote: Question 12 (Phong). Let X -> CP^2 be the blow up of the complex projective plane at one point. This is a DelPezzo surface, hence its first Chern class is positive. Pick omega in c1(X) a Kahler form, D a smooth anticanonical divisor, and let mu_D = omega wedge [D]/V denote a normalized Lebesgue measure along D. Can one find phi_D in DMA(X, omega) such that MA(phi_D) = mu_D ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\pi\colon X\to\mathbb{CP}^2$ be the blow-up of the complex projective plane at one point; then $X$ is a del Pezzo surface and its first Chern class $c_1(X)=-c_1(K_X)$ is positive. Fix a Kähler form $\omega$ representing $c_1(X)$, and let $V=\int_X\omega^2$. Let $D\subset X$ be a smooth divisor in the anticanonical linear system $|-K_X|$, and let $[D]$ denote the current of integration along $D$. Define the probability measure
$$\mu_D=\frac{\omega\wedge[D]}{V}$$
on $X$ (which is supported on the pluripolar set $D$).

An $\omega$-plurisubharmonic function on $X$ is an upper semicontinuous function $\varphi\colon X\to[-\infty,\infty)$, not identically $-\infty$, such that $\omega+dd^c\varphi\ge 0$ as a current. Let $\mathrm{DMA}(X,\omega)$ denote the largest class of $\omega$-plurisubharmonic functions on which the complex Monge–Ampère operator $\mathrm{MA}(\varphi)=(\omega+dd^c\varphi)^2$ can be defined as a positive Radon measure satisfying the standard convergence/locality properties (the natural domain of definition of the Monge–Ampère operator on $X$).

Question: Does there exist $\varphi_D\in\mathrm{DMA}(X,\omega)$ such that
$$\mathrm{MA}(\varphi_D)=\mu_D\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: A 2024–2025 preprint on characterizing the range of the complex Monge–Ampère operator explicitly cites this question of Phong and develops general solvability results for measures with a pluripolar part, but it provides only conditional/general theorems (e.g., solvability given an a priori solution for the singular part) and does not resolve the specific case of $\mu_D=\omega\wedge[D]/V$ on the one-point blow-up of $\mathbb{CP}^2$. No reference found that settles the question.

status_evidence.title: Characterizing the range of the complex Monge–Ampère operator
